role: re-run review after the single permitted fix pass

reviewers.role: website builder, own instrumented checks and repairs

finding_disposition.summary: 20 px horizontal document overflow at a 320 px viewport, caused by minmax(320px, 1fr) auto-fit tracks
finding_disposition.fix: every auto-fit and auto-fill grid minimum wrapped in min(..., 100%), and min-width: 0 set on grid children
finding_disposition.reverified_by: Playwright layout probe at 320, 375, 414, 768, 1024 and 1440 px
finding_disposition.evidence_after_fix: scrollWidth equals clientWidth at all six widths; overflow 0 px everywhere

finding_disposition.summary: table links rendered 17 px tall, far below the 44 px pointer-target guidance
finding_disposition.fix: td a, th a set to inline-block with min-height 44px and vertical padding
finding_disposition.reverified_by: Playwright bounding-box measurement of every anchor at 375 px

finding_disposition.summary: horizontally scrolling table containers were not keyboard focusable and had no accessible name
finding_disposition.fix: each wrapper is now a native <section> with tabindex="0" and a distinct aria-label, plus a visible focus ring

finding_disposition.summary: secondary button boundary failed the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast minimum
finding_disposition.reverified_by: WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance computation on the CSS custom properties

finding_disposition.summary: fixed 84 px scroll-margin-top did not match a sticky header that wraps to four rows on small screens
finding_disposition.fix: below 760 px the header is no longer sticky and the reserved scroll margin drops to 16 px
finding_disposition.evidence_after_fix: no sticky header at narrow widths, so no anchored heading can be obscured and the header no longer consumes a quarter of the viewport

finding_disposition.summary: in-page nav reached six of the eight top-level sections
finding_disposition.fix: Scope and Colophon entries added to the nav
finding_disposition.evidence_after_fix: 8 nav entries, every href fragment resolves to an existing id, no dead fragments

finding_disposition.summary: masthead link 38 px tall and bundle file-list links 41 px tall at 375 px
finding_disposition.fix: .brand made an inline-flex 44 px target; .file-list a padding raised and alignment centred
finding_disposition.reverified_by: Playwright bounding-box measurement of every anchor at 375 px

finding_disposition.summary: the page linked to and described as settled fact three review and receipt files that did not exist, asserting a completed acceptance while the review was still running
finding_disposition.fix: the three records were written with their real content, and the page copy now describes what each record contains -- a second-pass review after one fix pass, and a receipt of commands actually run with observed exit statuses -- instead of asserting an acceptance the records do not themselves show
finding_disposition.reverified_by: structural checker local-link resolution over every href and src
finding_disposition.evidence_after_fix: all local link targets resolve to non-empty files, including reviews/website-review.json and receipts/website.json; all seven published JSON records parse

finding_disposition.summary: the Haskell equivalence gate was described with two of its five conditions
finding_disposition.fix: copy now names all four preservation flags -- symplectic structure, Hamiltonian, dynamics, interpretation -- together with the empty known-losses requirement
finding_disposition.reverified_by: direct comparison against physicallyEquivalent in formal/haskell/Core.hs
finding_disposition.evidence_after_fix: site wording matches the conjunction in the source exactly

finding_disposition.summary: 64-character SHA-256 strings did not contribute a breakable min-content width
finding_disposition.evidence_after_fix: no element right edge exceeds the viewport at any tested width

accessibility_audit.incomplete_note: axe cannot resolve contrast automatically where a translucent sticky header overlays content; every pair was computed manually instead and the lowest measured text ratio is 7.75:1

contrast.method: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance, computed over every foreground/background pair in use

social_card.note: drawn with Pillow 12.3.0, not a PDF thumbnail

content_verification.independent_check: the research-communication reviewer independently recomputed every per-label count, the 34-page total, the 113-claim total, both formal-artifact line counts and all published SHA-256 values from the sources and reported no mismatch

notes: All ten first-pass findings were repaired in one fix pass and re-verified with the tool that raised them. One fix pass of the two permitted was used.
